item.title: ICE agents seen at Reagan National, Dulles as shutdown strains TSA staffing

item.title: Sanders, AOC propose halt on new AI data centers
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez are announcing the Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act, a bill aimed at blocking construction of new data centers in order to implement protections for the environment and surrounding communities.

item.title: Parents raise new concerns over MCPS boundary 'Option H' proposal
item.description: Montgomery County Public Schools is set to vote Thursday on a major school boundary proposal with many parents already voicing opposition to the "Option H" plan that would move Wootton High School. However, there's another set of parents raising a different concern within the "Modified Option H" proposal, that they claim could create a segregated environment.

item.title: TSA wait times: How to check security delays at DCA, BWI and Dulles
item.description: As long lines continue to snarl security checkpoints at U.S. airports amid ongoing staffing shortages, travelers can monitor estimated wait times online before heading out.
